id: # One row per paper. id = IEEE article number (last number in the Xplore URL). Empty keeps the automatic value; - or NA removes it.

type: Hybrid or System (PMIC/charger/harvester). arch/app take several values separated by ";" (e.g. Buck;Multi-level). by naming an AI tool (Codex
app: Claude ...) marks the row as AI-extracted.

vout: 10u); pout in W; eff in %; fsw in Hz (70M); ind in H (4.7n); pd in W/mm2; cd in A/mm2; node in nm; area in mm2.
